impacts.label: Emissions and climate
impacts.definition: GHG/CO2 emissions, avoided emissions, carbon footprint and climate-change effects or vulnerability linked to the technology.
impacts.inclusion: Avoided/increased CO2 or GHG, mitigation potential, carbon credits, GWP, El Nino-climate effects.
impacts.exclusion: Local air pollutants and health (pollution-waste-health); fossil fuel use without an emissions statement (energy-savings-fossil-displacement).

impacts.label: Land, water and biodiversity
impacts.definition: Effects on land use, water resources, ecosystems, species, soils, landscape and agriculture.
impacts.inclusion: Deforestation, habitat loss, water use/availability, bird and bat mortality, land requirements, landscape and noise, agricultural land competition.
impacts.exclusion: Land conflicts and dispossession of communities (conflicts-indigenous-territories); contamination of water by waste (pollution-waste-health) only when pollution is the main point.

impacts.label: Pollution, waste and health
impacts.definition: Local air, water and soil pollution, waste streams, safety risks and human-health effects.
impacts.inclusion: Particulates, NOx/SOx, acidification, eutrophication, toxicity, e-waste, battery end-of-life, effluents, accidents, respiratory illness, indoor smoke.

impacts.label: Energy savings and fossil displacement
impacts.definition: Changes in energy consumption, efficiency gains, rebound effects and displacement of diesel, coal, gas or other fossil fuels.
impacts.inclusion: Energy savings, peak flattening, rebound/backfire, reduced diesel or coal dependence, demand growth.
impacts.exclusion: Reliability of supply (energy-security-reliability); bill savings framed as money (cost-affordability).

impacts.label: Energy access and energy poverty
impacts.definition: Availability, quality and use of electricity or clean energy services for households and communities lacking them.
impacts.inclusion: Electrification, hours of service, firewood and cooking, unmet needs, quality of life, basic needs, education/health services enabled by power.
impacts.exclusion: Distributional unfairness between groups (energy-justice-equity); remote-region development (rural-development-zni).

impacts.label: Employment and local economy
impacts.definition: Effects on jobs, incomes, livelihoods, value chains, regional or national economic activity and fiscal revenue.
impacts.inclusion: Job creation or losses (e.g. coal mining), income generation, local wealth, SMEs, tourism, royalties, GDP, market effects.
impacts.exclusion: Consumer tariffs and bills (cost-affordability); distributive equity (energy-justice-equity).

impacts.label: Acceptance and participation
impacts.definition: Social acceptance, perception, community engagement, ownership, capacity building and social capital around projects.
impacts.inclusion: Community acceptance or rejection, NIMBY, trust, training, awareness, community energy, participation in decisions, cultural change.
impacts.exclusion: Open conflict, opposition or dispossession involving indigenous or ethnic territories (conflicts-indigenous-territories).

impacts.label: Conflicts and indigenous territories
impacts.definition: Social conflict, dispossession, displacement and territorial disputes, especially involving Wayuu, indigenous, Afro-Colombian and peasant communities.
impacts.inclusion: Wayuu/La Guajira wind-farm disputes, prior consultation failures, militarization, displacement by dams, land concentration, post-conflict territorial issues.
impacts.exclusion: Mere low acceptance without conflict (acceptance-participation); generic land-use change (land-water-biodiversity).

impacts.label: Energy justice and equity
impacts.definition: Fairness in the distribution of benefits and burdens across income groups, strata, gender and vulnerable populations.
impacts.inclusion: Regressive tariffs, cross-subsidies, non-adopter burden, gender effects, just-transition concerns, income inequality.
impacts.exclusion: Absence of access as such (energy-access-poverty); jobs in general (employment-local-economy).

impacts.label: Cost and affordability
impacts.definition: Effects on energy prices, tariffs, bills, financial viability and fiscal cost for consumers, utilities and the state.
impacts.inclusion: Lower or higher bills and tariffs, subsidy cost, payback, utility financial stress, priced externalities.
impacts.exclusion: Equity of who pays (energy-justice-equity); jobs and income (employment-local-economy).

impacts.label: Energy security and reliability
impacts.definition: Effects on security, reliability, resilience and diversification of the energy supply system.
impacts.inclusion: Outages, intermittent service, matrix diversification, drought-vulnerable hydropower, grid losses, storage and continuity of critical services.
impacts.exclusion: Fossil displacement per se (energy-savings-fossil-displacement); access for unserved populations (energy-access-poverty).

impacts.label: Rural development and non-interconnected zones
impacts.definition: Territorial development effects in rural, remote and non-interconnected zones (ZNI), islands and the regions where technologies are deployed.
impacts.inclusion: Rural development, ZNI/NIZ conditions, infrastructure (roads), regional imbalances, development of remote communities, regional development policy outcomes.

impacts.label: Other / general
impacts.definition: Impacts that fit no other code (e.g. generic SDG contribution statements).
impacts.inclusion: Generic SDG alignment, unspecific sustainability remarks.
impacts.exclusion: Anything that fits a substantive code.

gaps.label: Empirical validation and field data
gaps.definition: Need for real-world data, pilots, field tests, validation of models or prototypes and better data quality.
gaps.inclusion: Field validation, pilot studies, measurement campaigns, data scarcity or inaccessibility, calibration, larger real samples.

gaps.label: Long-term and lifecycle assessment
gaps.definition: Need for longitudinal studies, longer time horizons, lifecycle (LCA/LCSA) and durability or end-of-life analysis.
gaps.inclusion: Long-term monitoring, LCA/LCSA, degradation, seasonality, time-series length, adoption curves over time.
gaps.exclusion: Static environmental impact studies without a lifecycle or time angle (environmental-impact-assessment).

gaps.label: Social and community dimension
gaps.definition: Need to study social, community, cultural, gender, justice and stakeholder aspects and perception or acceptance.
gaps.inclusion: Community participation, ethnic and gender dimensions, perception surveys, justice, social conflicts, user behaviour, workforce and training.
gaps.exclusion: Cost of social programmes (cost-financing); policy instruments (policy-regulatory-design).

gaps.label: Policy and regulatory design
gaps.definition: Need for policy, regulatory, market-design and institutional research or reform.
gaps.inclusion: Regulation of DG and prosumers, incentives and tariffs design, market rules, standards, governance, roadmaps, public programmes.

gaps.label: Cost and financing
gaps.definition: Need for economic, cost, financing, investment and business-model analysis.
gaps.inclusion: Techno-economic analysis, CAPEX/OPEX, WACC, green bonds, funding mechanisms, willingness to pay, abatement cost, cost-benefit.
gaps.exclusion: Policy design with no financial focus (policy-regulatory-design).

gaps.label: System-level integration
gaps.definition: Need to integrate technologies in power, mobility or energy systems: grid, storage, digitalization, sector coupling and operation.
gaps.inclusion: Grid integration, storage, microgrids, smart-grid and cybersecurity, dispatch, charging, demand response, stability, interoperability.

gaps.label: Technology development and scale-up
gaps.definition: Need for R&D, process improvement, prototyping, scaling-up or deployment of a specific technology.
gaps.inclusion: Efficiency improvement, reactor or process design, scale-up, new materials, feasibility of specific technologies, commercialization, logistics.
gaps.exclusion: System-level integration (system-integration); validation with field data (empirical-validation-data).

gaps.label: Environmental impact assessment
gaps.definition: Need to quantify environmental effects, emissions, water, land and biodiversity impacts of technologies.
gaps.inclusion: GHG and land-use change quantification, environmental risk and EIA, water impacts, waste management, biodiversity.

gaps.label: Resource and potential assessment
gaps.definition: Need for better characterization of renewable resources, feedstocks, potentials and geospatial data.
gaps.inclusion: Wind/solar resource measurement, biomass availability, geothermal exploration, waste characterization, spatial/GIS data and databases.
gaps.exclusion: Validation of model results with real operation data (empirical-validation-data).

gaps.label: Model and method refinement
gaps.definition: Need to extend or refine models, indicators, optimization, multi-criteria or scenario methods and sensitivity/uncertainty analysis.
gaps.inclusion: Sensitivity and uncertainty analysis, additional variables or objectives, MCDM weights, algorithm comparison, scenario extension.
gaps.exclusion: Data collection (empirical-validation-data); system components to add as technologies (system-integration).

gaps.label: Regional coverage and replication
gaps.definition: Need to replicate, generalize or compare findings in other regions, countries, sectors or contexts.
gaps.inclusion: Other regions or countries, broader samples, comparability, scaling of findings, national coverage.

gaps.label: Other / unclassified
gaps.definition: Gaps that fit no other code.
gaps.exclusion: Anything that fits a substantive code.
